champions.name: Talon
champions.title: the Blade's Shadow

abilities.P: Blade's End: 3 abilities/AAs on same target → bleed for massive damage
abilities.Q: Noxian Diplomacy: stab in melee (crit if in range) or ranged poke
abilities.W: Rake: throw+return blades in cone. Return slows
abilities.E: Assassin's Path: vault over any terrain (per-wall CD). Unique roaming tool
abilities.R: Shadow Assault: become invisible + ring of blades. Converge for AoE when breaking stealth

champions.playstyle: Roaming assassin. E parkour over walls = fastest roamer. Passive bleed for burst.

champions.name: Teemo
champions.title: the Swift Scout

abilities.P: Guerrilla Warfare: camouflage after 1.5s still. Exiting = AS boost
abilities.Q: Blinding Dart: targeted blind + magic damage. Blocks AAs
abilities.W: Move Quick: passive MS. Active: doubled MS (breaks on damage)
abilities.E: Toxic Shot: AAs poison dealing magic DoT
abilities.R: Noxious Trap: place invisible mushroom traps. Step on = AoE slow + poison damage

champions.playstyle: Lane bully. Blind shuts down auto-attackers. Shrooms for map control + damage.

champions.name: Thresh
champions.title: the Chain Warden

abilities.P: Damnation: collect souls from minion/champ deaths for permanent armor + AP
abilities.Q: Death Sentence: hook skillshot → pull toward you. Recast: dash to hooked target
abilities.W: Dark Passage: throw lantern to location. Ally can click to dash to Thresh + shield
abilities.E: Flay: sweep enemies in direction (push or pull) + passive AA empowerment
abilities.R: The Box: create pentagon of walls. First wall hit = massive slow + damage

champions.playstyle: Playmaker support. Hook engage. Lantern saves allies. Flay peels. R zones.

champions.name: Tristana
champions.title: the Yordle Gunner

abilities.P: Draw a Bead: attack range increases per level (longest range late game)
abilities.Q: Rapid Fire: massive AS steroid for 7s
abilities.W: Rocket Jump: leap to location dealing AoE + slow. Resets on kill/assist or E detonation
abilities.E: Explosive Charge: place bomb on target. AAs stack it. At 4 stacks = massive explosion
abilities.R: Buster Shot: knock target back + massive damage. Self-peel execute

champions.playstyle: All-in ADC. W jump reset on kills = snowball. E bomb burst. R self-peel.

champions.name: Tryndamere
champions.title: the Barbarian King

abilities.P: Battle Fury: crits generate fury. More fury = more crit chance
abilities.Q: Bloodlust: passive AD scaling missing HP. Active: heal (scales with fury consumed)
abilities.W: Mocking Shout: AoE AD reduction. Slow enemies facing away
abilities.E: Spinning Slash: dash through enemies dealing damage. CD reduced by crits
abilities.R: Undying Rage: CANNOT DIE for 5s. Cannot be reduced below 1 HP. No counterplay.

champions.playstyle: Split-push king. R = unkillable for 5s. Crit-based scaling. Forces 2+ to answer.

champions.name: Twisted Fate
champions.title: the Card Master

abilities.P: Loaded Dice: bonus gold on unit kills
abilities.Q: Wild Cards: throw 3 cards in cone dealing magic damage
abilities.W: Pick a Card: cycle through Blue (mana restore), Red (AoE slow), Gold (stun). Gold is key
abilities.E: Stacked Deck: every 4th AA deals bonus magic. Passive AS
abilities.R: Destiny: reveal all enemies globally. Recast: teleport to target location (semi-global)

champions.playstyle: Map-control mage. R teleport ganks with Gold Card stun. Global pressure.

champions.name: Twitch
champions.title: the Plague Rat

abilities.P: Deadly Venom: AAs and abilities apply poison stacks (max 6). Deals true damage/s
abilities.Q: Ambush: enter camouflage + AS boost when revealing. Resets on takedown
abilities.W: Venom Cask: AoE slow zone + apply poison stacks
abilities.E: Contaminate: deal physical damage to all poisoned enemies (scales with stacks)
abilities.R: Spray and Pray: gain bonus range + AD. AAs pierce through targets in a line

champions.playstyle: Stealth ADC. Q invisible for flanks. R for teamfight AoE piercing autos.

champions.name: Urgot
champions.title: the Dreadnought

abilities.P: Echoing Flames: 6 legs with individual CDs. AAs from each direction fire shotgun blast (%max HP)
abilities.Q: Corrosive Charge: skillshot AoE slow + damage
abilities.W: Purge: toggle rapid-fire AAs at nearest enemy. Reduced MS during. Triggers legs
abilities.E: Disdain: dash + flip enemy over you (behind). Shield on cast
abilities.R: Fear Beyond Death: skillshot execute. If target drops below 25% HP → reel in + execute (suppress + kill)

champions.playstyle: Ranged juggernaut. Rotate legs for %HP damage. R execute is terrifying finisher.

champions.name: Varus
champions.title: the Arrow of Retribution

abilities.P: Living Vengeance: kills grant AS boost
abilities.Q: Piercing Arrow: charge Q for increased range + damage. Long-range poke
abilities.W: Blighted Quiver: passive: AAs apply blight (3 stacks). Abilities detonate for %max HP magic
abilities.E: Hail of Arrows: AoE + grievous wounds zone + slow
abilities.R: Chain of Corruption: root skillshot that spreads to nearby enemies after delay

champions.playstyle: Hybrid poke ADC. Q poke. W blight stacks for %HP burst. R AoE root engage.

champions.name: Vayne
champions.title: the Night Hunter

abilities.P: Night Hunter: bonus MS moving toward enemy champions
abilities.Q: Tumble: short dash + next AA deals bonus damage. R = invisible during Tumble
abilities.W: Silver Bolts: every 3rd AA on same target deals %max HP true damage
abilities.E: Condemn: knock target back. If target hits wall = stun + bonus damage
abilities.R: Final Hour: bonus AD + enhanced passive MS + Tumble grants invisibility. Duration extends on kills

champions.playstyle: Tank-shredding hypercarry. W true damage melts anyone. Short range demands skill.

champions.name: Veigar
champions.title: the Tiny Master of Evil

abilities.P: Phenomenal Evil Power: ability hits on champs + Q last-hits grant permanent AP stacks
abilities.Q: Baleful Strike: line skillshot. Killing units grants +1 AP permanently
abilities.W: Dark Matter: delayed AoE nuke from sky
abilities.E: Event Horizon: create cage (pentagon). Enemies touching walls are STUNNED
abilities.R: Primordial Burst: point-click nuke. Deals bonus damage based on target's missing HP

champions.playstyle: Infinite AP scaling mage. E cage is zone control. R point-click deletes squishies late.

champions.name: Vel'Koz
champions.title: the Eye of the Void

abilities.P: Organic Deconstruction: 3 ability hits = bonus true damage proc
abilities.Q: Plasma Fission: skillshot that splits at 90° angles at recast/max range
abilities.W: Void Rift: line AoE that opens after delay for second hit
abilities.E: Tectonic Disruption: AoE knockup (small) in line
abilities.R: Lifeform Disintegration Ray: channel massive laser in direction. Applies passive rapidly. True damage with 3 procs

champions.playstyle: Artillery mage. Geometry Q angles. R laser melts grouped enemies. Passive = true damage.

champions.name: Vex
champions.title: the Gloomist

abilities.P: Doom 'n Gloom: abilities apply Gloom. Dashing/blinking enemies near Vex get feared (limited CD)
abilities.Q: Mistral Bolt: line skillshot + accelerating wave
abilities.W: Personal Space: AoE burst around self + shield
abilities.E: Looming Darkness: AoE shadow that slows + deals damage + applies Gloom
abilities.R: Shadow Surge: fire shadow in line. On hit, dash to enemy + AoE damage. Resets on kill

champions.playstyle: Anti-mobility burst mage. Fear dashing enemies. R dashes to target for burst.

champions.name: Vi
champions.title: the Piltover Enforcer

abilities.P: Blast Shield: ability use grants shield based on max HP
abilities.Q: Vault Breaker: charge dash. Longer charge = more range + damage. Knocks back on hit
abilities.W: Denting Blows: 3 hits on same target = %max HP bonus + AS buff
abilities.E: Relentless Force: next 2 AAs deal bonus damage + 3rd is AoE wave
abilities.R: Cease and Desist: dash to target champion (unstoppable). Suppress + knockup on arrival + AoE knockup

champions.playstyle: Lockdown jungler. Q charge engage. R point-click suppress on priority target.

champions.name: Viego
champions.title: the Ruined King

abilities.P: Sovereign's Domination: killing champs lets you possess their body (use their abilities)
abilities.Q: Blade of the Ruined King: AA deals %current HP bonus. Q stab heals
abilities.W: Spectral Maw: charge → dash + stun on hit (longer charge = longer stun)
abilities.E: Harrowed Path: send wraith through terrain. Inside: camouflage + AS + MS
abilities.R: Heartbreaker: blink to target, dealing %missing HP damage. Execute resets on possession

champions.playstyle: Reset assassin/bruiser. Kill → possess → heal → R reset. Snowball monster in teamfights.

champions.name: Viktor
champions.title: the Machine Herald

abilities.P: Glorious Evolution: hex core upgrades abilities. Evolve with gold spent on unique item
abilities.Q: Siphon Power: shield + empowered next AA (bonus magic). Evolve: MS
abilities.W: Gravity Field: zone that stacks slow → stun at max stacks
abilities.E: Death Ray: line laser. Evolve: aftershock explosion along same path
abilities.R: Chaos Storm: AoE DoT storm that follows cursor. Interrupts on initial cast

champions.playstyle: Scaling control mage. Evolved E = massive waveclear + poke. R zone control.

champions.name: Vladimir
champions.title: the Crimson Reaper

abilities.P: Crimson Pact: bonus HP from AP, bonus AP from HP
abilities.Q: Transfusion: point-click drain. Every 3rd Q is empowered (more damage + heal + MS)
abilities.W: Sanguine Pool: become untargetable (puddle). AoE slow + damage. Costs HP
abilities.E: Tides of Blood: charge AoE. More charge = more damage + slow (costs HP)
abilities.R: Hemoplague: AoE mark. After 4s, detonates for magic damage. Marked targets take 10% increased damage from all sources

champions.playstyle: Scaling AP drain tank. W untargetable pool. R amplifies team damage. No mana = infinite sustain.

champions.name: Volibear
champions.title: the Relentless Storm

abilities.P: The Relentless Storm: AAs grant stacking AS. At max stacks, chain lightning on-hit
abilities.Q: Thundering Smash: gain MS toward champs. Next AA stuns + bonus damage
abilities.W: Frenzied Maul: bite dealing %HP damage. Heals if target was recently bitten (wound mechanic)
abilities.E: Sky Splitter: call lightning at location. Shield + %max HP magic damage. Scales with HP
abilities.R: Stormbringer: leap to location. Disable turret. Gain bonus HP + size. AoE slow on landing

champions.playstyle: Frontline bruiser. R disables turrets for dives. W sustain in extended fights.

champions.name: Warwick
champions.title: the Uncaged Wrath of Zaun

abilities.P: Eternal Hunger: AAs deal bonus magic + heal. Below 50% HP = 3x healing
abilities.Q: Jaws of the Beast: lunge to target dealing %max HP magic. Hold to dash behind target
abilities.W: Blood Hunt: passive: sense low-HP enemies globally (MS + AS toward them). Active: enhanced for all enemies
abilities.E: Primal Howl: gain damage reduction. Recast: fear nearby enemies
abilities.R: Infinite Duress: long-range suppression leap. Applies on-hit effects 3 times. Heals per hit

champions.playstyle: Sustain jungler. W tracks low HP enemies. R long-range lockdown. Great for beginners.

champions.name: Wukong
champions.title: the Monkey King

abilities.P: Stone Skin: gain bonus armor/MR near enemy champions (stacks per champion)
abilities.Q: Crushing Blow: AA reset + bonus damage + armor shred
abilities.W: Warrior Trickster: become invisible briefly + leave clone. Clone attacks + explodes
abilities.E: Nimbus Strike: dash to target + clone attacks nearby enemies. Bonus AS after
abilities.R: Cyclone: spin dealing AoE physical + knockup. Can recast for 2nd spin. Double knockup!

champions.playstyle: Teamfight diver. R double-knockup = game-winning CC. W clone for outplays.

champions.name: Xayah
champions.title: the Rebel

abilities.P: Clean Cuts: after ability, next 3 AAs throw feathers through targets leaving feathers on ground
abilities.Q: Double Daggers: throw 2 daggers in line. Each leaves feather
abilities.W: Deadly Plumage: gain AS + MS. If Rakan is nearby, he also gains it
abilities.E: Bladecaller: recall ALL feathers. Enemies hit by 3+ feathers are rooted
abilities.R: Featherstorm: leap up (untargetable) + throw feathers in cone. Safety + damage + feather setup

champions.playstyle: Feather-root ADC. Setup feathers behind enemies then E root for lockdown. R = untargetable.

champions.name: Xin Zhao
champions.title: the Seneschal of Demacia

abilities.P: Determination: every 3rd AA heals
abilities.Q: Three Talon Strike: next 3 AAs deal bonus damage. 3rd AA knocks up
abilities.W: Wind Becomes Lightning: slash + thrust dealing AoE damage + slow
abilities.E: Audacious Charge: dash to target + AoE slow + AS buff
abilities.R: Crescent Guard: AoE sweep + for 3s, block all damage from enemies farther than Xin's AA range

champions.playstyle: Early game ganker. E dash + Q knockup for ganks. R blocks ranged damage.

champions.name: Yasuo
champions.title: the Unforgiven

abilities.P: Way of the Wanderer: shield from Flow (charge by moving). Double crit chance (halved crit damage)
abilities.Q: Steel Tempest: line stab. 3rd Q = tornado knockup (ranged skillshot)
abilities.W: Wind Wall: create wall blocking ALL enemy projectiles for 4s
abilities.E: Sweeping Blade: dash through enemy. Can't dash same target twice quickly
abilities.R: Last Breath: blink to airborne enemy. Suspend + deal damage + bonus armor pen for 15s after

champions.playstyle: High-skill melee carry. Dash through minions. Windwall blocks projectiles. R on knockups.

champions.name: Yone
champions.title: the Unforgotten

abilities.P: Way of the Hunter: double crit chance. Every 2nd AA deals bonus magic damage
abilities.Q: Mortal Steel: stab. 3rd Q = dash + knockup (like Yasuo Q3)
abilities.W: Spirit Cleave: AoE sweep dealing %max HP mixed damage + shield
abilities.E: Soul Unbound: leave body → become spirit (bonus MS). Recast: snap back to body + deal stored damage
abilities.R: Fate Sealed: long-range dash + pull all enemies along path to endpoint + knockup

champions.playstyle: Dual-damage skirmisher. E engages allow risk-free trades. R is massive engage tool.

champions.name: Yuumi
champions.title: the Magical Cat

abilities.P: Bop 'n' Block: periodically, AA grants shield + restores mana. Need to detach to proc
abilities.Q: Prowling Projectile: guided skillshot. Deals more damage at range. Slow on hit
abilities.W: You and Me!: attach to ally. While attached, share adaptive stats. Can detach/reattach freely
abilities.E: Zoomies: heal + AS + MS to attached ally (or self)
abilities.R: Final Chapter: channel waves dealing magic damage. Each wave roots enemies hit by 3+ waves

champions.playstyle: Attach enchanter. Sit on carry, buff them. Untargetable while attached. R for AoE roots.

champions.name: Zed
champions.title: the Master of Shadows

abilities.P: Contempt for the Weak: AA deals bonus %max HP magic to targets below 50% HP
abilities.Q: Razor Shuriken: throw shuriken in line. Shadow also throws. Overlap = bonus damage
abilities.W: Living Shadow: place shadow clone. Can swap positions. Shadow mimics Q and E
abilities.E: Shadow Slash: AoE around self + shadow. Slow if both hit. Reduces W CD
abilities.R: Death Mark: dash to target (untargetable). Mark stores % of damage dealt → detonates after 3s

champions.playstyle: AD assassin. W shadow combos for poke. R all-in for kill. QSS/Stasis counter R.

champions.name: Zeri
champions.title: the Spark of Zaun

abilities.P: Living Battery: gain MS from shields. Absorb enemy shields on AA
abilities.Q: Burst Fire: AA = skillshot. Q = rapid electric pulse (main DPS)
abilities.W: Ultrashock Laser: line skillshot. Through terrain = longer + wider
abilities.E: Spark Surge: dash. Through terrain = extended range. Energizes next few Q casts
abilities.R: Lightning Crash: AoE discharge. Gain MS + stacking zap damage on hits for duration. Extends on hit

champions.playstyle: Mobile ADC with skillshot AAs. E dashes through walls. R grants ramping MS+damage.

champions.name: Ziggs
champions.title: the Hexplosives Expert

abilities.P: Short Fuse: periodically, next AA deals bonus magic damage. CD reduced by abilities
abilities.Q: Bouncing Bomb: throw bomb that bounces (3 times). AoE magic on each bounce or on champion hit
abilities.W: Satchel Charge: place bomb. Detonates: knockback self/enemies + damage. Executes turrets below threshold
abilities.E: Hexplosive Minefield: scatter mines. Each deals magic + slow. More mines = less damage per mine
abilities.R: Mega Inferno Bomb: massive global AoE bomb. Huge damage in center

champions.playstyle: Siege/poke mage. Q spam for poke. W satchel for mobility. R global AoE nuke.

champions.name: Zilean
champions.title: the Chronokeeper

abilities.P: Time in a Bottle: store XP to level up allies faster
abilities.Q: Time Bomb: place bomb on target/ground. Explodes after 3s. 2 bombs on same target = AoE stun
abilities.W: Rewind: reduce Q and E cooldowns by a large amount
abilities.E: Time Warp: speed up ally or slow down enemy massively (99%)
abilities.R: Chronoshift: place revive on ally. If they die within 5s, they resurrect with HP

champions.playstyle: Utility support. Double Q stun. E massive speed/slow. R is free Guardian Angel for carry.

champions.name: Zoe
champions.title: the Aspect of Twilight

abilities.P: More Sparkles: after ability, next AA deals bonus magic damage
abilities.Q: Paddle Star: throw star that redirects toward cursor on recast. Damage scales with distance traveled
abilities.W: Spell Thief: pick up summoner spells/item actives dropped by enemies. Use them once
abilities.E: Sleepy Trouble Bubble: skillshot that puts target to sleep. First hit after sleep deals bonus true damage. Passes through walls
abilities.R: Portal Jump: blink to location then blink back after 1s. Extends Q/E range. Can be interrupted

champions.playstyle: One-shot poke mage. E sleep into long-range Q for massive burst. W steals spells.

champions.name: Zyra
champions.title: Rise of the Thorns

abilities.P: Garden of Thorns: periodically spawn seeds. Seeds become plants when hit by abilities
abilities.Q: Deadly Spines: line AoE. Seeds in area become ranged thorn plants
abilities.W: Rampant Growth: place seed. Store 2 charges. Plants deal magic damage auto-attacking enemies
abilities.E: Grasping Roots: line root. Seeds in area become short-range plants that slow
abilities.R: Stranglethorns: AoE damage + after delay, knockup all enemies in zone. Enrages plants

champions.playstyle: Zone control support. Plants deal constant damage. E root for CC. R AoE knockup in teamfights.
